michigan.linePrev: Things will end before they start
stanza: Sleeping on Lake Michigan
Factories and marching bands
Lose our clothes in summertime
Lose ourselves to lose our minds
In the summer heat, I might
I'd swim across Lake Michigan
I'd sell my shoes
I'd give my body to be back again
In the rest of the room

michigan.linePrev: There was trouble in a roadhouse
michigan.lineNext: There was a kid lying on the floor, looking bad
stanza: Well, the night was like any other
I got a call 'bout quarter to nine
There was trouble in a roadhouse
Out on the Michigan line
There was a kid lying on the floor, looking bad
Bleeding hard from his head
There was a girl crying at a table
And it was Frank, they said

michigan.linePrev: Well, I must've done a hundred and ten
michigan.lineNext: It was out at the crossroads
stanza: Well, I went out and I jumped in my car
And I hit the lights
Well, I must've done a hundred and ten
Through Michigan County that night
It was out at the crossroads
Down 'round Willow Bank
Seen a Buick with Ohio plates
Behind the wheel was Frank
Well, I chased him through them county roads
'Til a sign said "Canadian border, five miles from here"
I pulled over on the side of the highway
And watched his taillights disappear

michigan.linePrev: Well we were in at the kill again on the Milwaukee Mile
michigan.line: And in June up in Michigan we were robbed at Belle Isle
michigan.lineNext: Then it was on to Portland, Oregon for the G. I. Joe
stanza: Well we were in at the kill again on the Milwaukee Mile
And in June up in Michigan we were robbed at Belle Isle
Then it was on to Portland, Oregon for the G. I. Joe
And I'd blown off almost everyone when my motor let go
New England, Ontario we died in the dirt
Those walls from mid-Ohio to Toronto, they hurt
So we came to Road America where we burned up at the lake
But at the speedway at Nazareth I made no mistake

michigan.line: Michigan seems like a dream to me now
